I haven't fixed it, because the cause is in `config/default.json`, which CLAUDE.md says I can't change.

The `uploads` test fails because `config/default.json` sets `"uploads": { "maxMb": 5, ... }`. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value, so an 8 MB file is rejected. The documented limit in `docs/product.md` is 10 MB.

The fix is one line, `"maxMb": 5` → `"maxMb": 10`. It needs ops review, since production reads that file directly. `src/api/body-limit.js` also derives the request body limit from `maxMb`, so it would rise from 6 MB to 11 MB. That is correct, because an 8 MB upload can't get through a 6 MB body limit either.

I could instead override `maxMb` in `src/config.js`. That would make the test pass, but production would still have the wrong limit and the code would disagree with the config file. I don't recommend it.

Do you want me to make the one-line config change anyway so you can send it to ops, or should I use the `src/config.js` override?
